---
title: "Baby Names Over Time"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Read the baby names dataset
names_df <- read_csv("ssa-baby-names.csv")

# Filter for the name "Ethan" and plot over time
names_df |>
  filter(name == "Ethan") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = count, color = sex)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Popularity of the Name 'Ethan' Over Time",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Babies",
    color = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
